name: Hazel
source:
“I’m spoiled for choice, huh?”

Hazel is a nature-loving farmer. She’s much more comfortable in her natural fiber overalls and her trusty straw hat than the latest fashion trends. She’s apprehensive about her summons to the Woodland Forest Dating show, but she approaches it just like any challenge: keenly, with a pinch of sass! Plus, her best friend Ester is here, so it can’t be all bad. Who knows? She may make a friend or two. Perhaps even find love?

[From official profile]
